findings.evidence: The validation report records structure, scope, encoding, links, assets, status/evidence, vertical flows, safety, and handoff gates with PASS/WARN/BLOCK counts.
findings.why_it_matters: The final handoff needs a reproducible review boundary rather than a generic completion statement.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; rerun after any downstream requirement/ID change.

findings.evidence: The validator now includes the final validation report in UTF-8/placeholder/link scanning and permits explicitly documented prohibited-role names only as exclusions.
findings.why_it_matters: The structural gate must validate the handoff artifact itself without confusing scope exclusions with active actors.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; keep the exclusion-aware check narrow and review active role tables manually.

findings.evidence: The overall verdict is PASS for documentation readiness while client/provider/retention/generation decisions remain named TBD items.
findings.why_it_matters: A documentation gate should not be mistaken for product runtime acceptance.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; keep runtime execution and policy decisions as downstream gates.
